title: A Federated Approach to Few-Shot Hate Speech Detection for Marginalized Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating few-shot federated learning models and the Perspective API on their ability to detect localized hate speech directed at Black people using an Afrikaans dataset.
Measuring model and API performance in classifying hate speech targeted at the LGBTQ community across culturally specific datasets in Afrikaans and Russian.
Evaluating hate speech detection performance on datasets containing abusive language and slurs directed at Russians, Russophone Ukrainians, and Ukrainian war victims.
Collecting and utilizing a localized Korean dataset containing positive, neutral, and hateful sentences directed at women to evaluate hate speech detection models.

Analyzing the Perspective API's toxicity scores on low-resource, non-English datasets to reveal its failure to detect culturally specific slurs and its over-reliance on profanity as a proxy for hate speech.
